position: Senior Heavy Equipment Operator / Crew Lead — Night Shift
whatOccurred: adkfjads;kljfa;dkafj -- employee was observed operating the D6 dozer without wearing the required fall-protection harness while working along the elevated berm on the east side of the retention pond; a coworker (see witness statement, attached separately) reported the incident to the on-site foreman at approximately 2:15 PM; equipment was immediately shut down and the work area was secured pending review; this is the second such observation in the last thirty (30) days and directly violates Shackelford Construction & Hauling, LLC's written Fall Protection Policy, Section 4.2(b), as well as OSHA 1926.501(b)(1); a full incident debrief is attached as Exhibit A.
earlierWarnings: adslkfjadskfjadkf: Verbal warning issued 2026-07-02 for the same fall-protection concern near the same berm; written note placed in file 2026-07-15 following a near-miss on an unrelated piece of equipment (the 320 excavator); supervisor discussed expectations in person on both occasions and documented each conversation in the daily log.
companyPolicyStates: fadskfjaki;djfa;dsklfjad -- Per the Shackelford Construction and Hauling, LLC Safety Manual (Rev. 2026-03), Section 4.2(b): 'All employees working at elevation above six (6) feet on graded or ungraded surfaces adjacent to standing water, excavations, or drop-offs must wear an inspected, properly fitted fall-protection harness at all times, with no exceptions absent written authorization from the Safety Director.' Section 9.1 further requires immediate work stoppage upon any observed violation.
employeeStatement: afdfkadfal;dskfad: Employee stated he had removed the harness 'for just a minute' to adjust a hydraulic line and did not consider the berm edge to be within the six-foot fall-protection threshold; employee acknowledged the prior verbal warning and stated he understood the policy but did not believe it applied to that specific location on that specific day.
correctiveActionRequired: fadfljkadkfja;dslkfaj -- Employee must complete a documented fall-protection refresher training within five (5) business days of this notice; employee must wear the harness at all times when working within ten (10) feet of any elevation change greater than six (6) feet, with zero tolerance for any further exceptions; foreman will perform two (2) unannounced spot checks per week for the next thirty (30) days.
companyWill: adfladjfkadsjfa;dfa -- The Company will provide the required refresher training at no cost to the employee, will supply a replacement harness if the current one fails inspection, and will document all spot-check results in the employee's personnel file for the next 90 days.
ifNotCorrected: ad;kljfakdlfjads;lfa -- Further violations of the fall-protection policy will result in immediate suspension without pay pending investigation, up to and including termination of employment, consistent with Shackelford's progressive discipline policy, Section 12.
